messages:
Noah (AE): Quick sync please  BetaWorks POC asks for 60-day eval, waived usage + a 50% conversion discount on Dedicated if they sign within 120 days. Need an approval path and which CPQ template to use. Also they want our security questionnaire and a standard POC SOW with an SLA appendix.

Maya (Deal Desk): @Noah heads up: discounts over 30% always route to Deal Desk + Legal. For auto-routing set Opportunity fields in Salesforce exactly or our flow will skip it. Use CPQ Template: POC-Sales-Template-2025. Typical Deal Desk SLA = 48h, Legal adds 72h.

Oliver SE: Pricing mechanic idea: create a conditional discount schedule line in CPQ that applies a PostConversionDiscount on the Dedicated SKU. We can model conversion as an amendment quote. If you need it to be applied on hourly vs invoice, call out 'ApplyOnConversion=HourlyRate'. I'll spin up the SE SOW SLA appendix and the SecurityQA draft.

Rhea RevOps: Paste these fields into the opp internal notes so the approval automation picks it up:
```
Deal_Type__c = POC
POC_Length__c = 60
Discount_Requested__c = 50
Discount_Approval_Level__c = DealDesk
Approval_Route__c = DealDesk_Auto
Quote_Template__c = POC-Sales-Template-2025
POC_SOW_FileTag = POC_BetaWorks_SOW
Needs_Legal_Review__c = true
Internal_Note__c = '50% conditional on signing within 120 days; request Legal for SLA language'
```
Also set Opportunity Stage = 'POC Submitted'. If you attach SecurityQA under Files, our Deal Desk ticketer will include it.

Noah (AE): Two questions: 1) BetaWorks insists discount be applied to committed hourly rate on conversion (not a rebate). 2) They asked if we can auto-escalate to Director if ACV > $250k. Can that be automated?

Maya (Deal Desk): 1) That's fine - reflect ApplyOnConversion=HourlyRate in the quote notes. 2) Yes RevOps can add an automation rule: if ACV >= 250000 and Discount_Requested__c >= 40 then Approval_Route__c -> DealDesk_DirectorEscalation. @Rhea can you add the workflow?

Rhea RevOps: I can add a workflow rule and a CPQ approval matrix. I'll create an approval template and an email template: dealdesk_poc_escalation. Expected rollout to pick up new opps within 15 minutes after save.

Carmen (Legal): Flag: any SLA language that changes uptime/credits or adds custom escalation steps needs Legal review. If Deal Desk tags Needs_Legal_Review__c = true we'll triage within 72 hours. For discounts >45% we require revenue justification and a legal signoff on indemnities.

Noah (AE): BetaWorks target ACV at conversion ~ $320k. I'll include revenue worksheet in the opp and add the POC SOW and SecurityQA.

Maya (Deal Desk): Good. When you submit, select Approval_Route__c = DealDesk_Auto and attach the files. I will validate CPQ lines and check if this needs Director (per the RevOps rule). If so I'll escalate to Percy or the Director group.

deal-bot: Ticket created: DD-4602 -> "BetaWorks 60d POC / Conditional 50% Discount". Deal Desk ETA: 48h. Legal ETA if flagged: 72h. Escalation: auto if ACV >= 250000 and discount >= 40%.

Noah (AE): Submitting now. Will ping when uploaded. Thanks for the templates and fields.

Maya (Deal Desk): Once it's in I will run a CPQ validation pass and post any missing fields to the ticket. If Legal is attached we'll note expected hold time. :thumbsup:

Noah (AE): Uploaded SOW + SecurityQA, set fields per checklist. Leaving internal note with revenue plan.

Rhea RevOps: Saw the opp, automation picked it up and routed to Deal Desk_Auto. Created approval record APPR-778.

Maya (Deal Desk): Reviewing APPR-778 now. CPQ lines look okay but you missed Discount_Code. Can you add Discount_Code = POC_BETA50 and re-submit?

Noah (AE): Added POC_BETA50. Re-submitted.

deal-bot: APPR-778 updated. Status = 'Under Review'. Reminder: Legal will be looped due to Needs_Legal_Review flag."
